_purpose: Phase-3 calibration probe — claude × 002-bank-ledger × llmll + codex × 002-bank-ledger × llmll = 2 cells at k=5 × 1 try. Verifies the harness pipeline (manifest → run_matrix.py → run_repair_loop.py → agent CLI → verifier chain → evaluator → matrix_report.json) works end-to-end for the two paid agents on the existing Phase-2-proven testkit. Excludes Gemini (already proven on Phase-2 calibration); excludes Python/Go targets (the differentiating signal is LLMLL; cross-language wiring is identical so a transit failure would surface on llmll first). Pre-Phase-3-launch cost-pinning step: order $5-$10 expected; if per-cell cost extrapolates above $5/cell, the 81-cell launch budget needs revisiting.
_timeout_note: Bumped from 540 to 1800 per postmortem-002-phase3-calibration-probe.md F-035 (2026-05-15): both Claude Code 2.1.141 and Codex 0.130.0 hit the 540s ceiling on turn 1 in the first probe attempt. Codex emitted a substantive 23-statement solution before being killed; Claude emitted 0 bytes (F-036 is the orthogonal diagnostic on Claude's silence — bumped timeout may also disambiguate it if hypothesis 1 / output-buffering is the cause). Phase-2 calibration's 540s was Gemini-calibrated; paid agents at default reasoning effort need more headroom.

llmll._s1_note: R6d universal Cred predicate. Same as manifest.phase3.json.

toolchain_pins._note: Compiler pin only — Python and Go pins omitted because this probe is llmll-only. run_matrix.py:check_toolchain_pins iterates the pins block; absent entries are silently skipped per discipline A (no-op for absent keys).

_circuit_breaker_note: Threshold lowered to 2 (vs phase3.json's 3) because the probe is 2 cells total — a single fail-fail sequence should trip the breaker on a probe of this size.

agents.name: claude-default

If context/turn_NN_verifier.json files exist, read the most recent before emitting. Write your solution to the filename(s) indicated in TARGET.md.'
agents.note: Claude Code CLI 2.1.141; OAuth/keychain auth (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY UNSET on this machine). Stage-1 verified 2026-05-15 at commit 7f323f6. --add-dir {run_dir} added per postmortem-002 Addendum 2 (F-036 hypothesis 5 remediation): the second probe surfaced that --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions alone is insufficient — Claude Code's session sandbox requires the run dir explicitly added to its allowed-working-directories set before Write/Bash tools can emit solution files. The {run_dir} placeholder is substituted with the absolute per-cell run dir by run_repair_loop.py:_invoke_real_agent before subprocess invocation (matching the existing {solution} placeholder pattern at _materialize_argv:472).
